title: Algorithmic Reflectivity in Large Language Models: Methodological Study of Linguistic Structure in Mentalization
abstract: arXiv:2512.08945v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mentalization is a core human capacity involving the interpretation of one's own and others' behavior in terms of underlying mental states. Large language models (LLMs) can generate linguistically reflective discourse, raising the question of whether the formal linguistic structure of mentalization can be reproduced without experiential and affective processes. This study assessed whether an LLM can generate mentalization profiles structurally coherent with the dimensions of mentalization-based treatment (MBT) and recognized as formally mentalizing by expert clinicians. Fifty human-model dialogues were generated with GPT-4.1 under standardized conditions; at the end of each, the model produced a narrative mentalization profile. Five MBT-trained psychiatrists independently rated each profile on 4 canonical MBT axes and 2 higher-order dimensions (regulatory functions, synthetic profile) for evaluative and argumentative coherence. translated_title: 大语言模型中的算法反身性：心智化语言结构的方法学研究
translated_abstract: 心智化（Mentalization）是人类的一种核心能力，指从潜在心理状态的角度来解释自己和他人的行为。大语言模型（LLMs）能够生成具有语言反思性的话语，这引出了一个问题：心智化的形式语言结构能否在缺乏体验性与情感性过程的情况下被再现。本研究评估了大语言模型能否生成与心智化基础治疗（MBT）各维度在结构上相一致的心智化画像，并被专业临床医生认定为形式上的心智化。研究在标准化条件下使用GPT-4.1生成了50段人机对话；在每段对话结束时，模型生成一份叙述性心智化画像。五位接受过MBT培训的精神科医生独立地对每份画像进行评分，评分涵盖4个经典MBT维度和2个高阶维度（调节功能、综合画像），以衡量其评价一致性与论证一致性。
tldr: 本研究通过让五位MBT受训精神科医生盲评GPT-4.1生成的心智化画像，证明大语言模型无需体验与情感过程，也能生成在语言结构上与心智化治疗维度一致、并被临床专家认可为形式上心智化的内容。
en_tdlr: This study shows that GPT-4.1 can generate mentalization profiles structurally coherent with mentalization-based treatment (MBT) dimensions and formally recognized as mentalizing by expert clinicians, without requiring experiential or affective processes.
